sources.summary: Copenhagen cleantech startup Everyday and architecture studio BIG have designed a minimalist home air purifier called Air. Described by Everyday as a complete "home climate system", Air brings together heating, cooling and air purification for the home. The startup worked with BIG to create a purposefully subtle design defined by clean, architectural lines.
